note: What may update and merge itself in this repository: read by `commitwork deps --update` (bin/lib/update-policy.mjs), which can only narrow an operator's settings by it, and by the CI job dependabot-merge (bin/dependency-policy-check.mjs). commitwork declares zero runtime dependencies, so production updates are empty and every npm package is a development one. cooldownDays matches .github/dependabot.yml, and bin/test/dependency-policy.test.mjs holds the two equal.
